//: Combination vertical foregrip + bipod (e.g. Grip Pod). Does both jobs, neither as well as a dedicated unit.
description: A vertical foregrip with spring-loaded legs folded into the body, combining a forward grip and a bipod in a single unit.  It is bulkier and heavier than either alone, and is a jack-of-both-trades: it steadies your aim like a foregrip and can brace like a bipod, but is less effective than a dedicated version of each.
